data.text:
[6:34AM] #Apapa
#Ajegunle
#TrafficUpdate

The movement of vehicles from both Ojo road and Otto Wharf to Ajeromi is fast moving traffic.

From Ajeromi junction all commercial buses are diverted to Ojora way to connect Boundary bus stop.

From Baale street to the Boundary roundabout an appreciable movement .

The stretch of Mobil road (both inward and outward) at the moment is a fast moving vehicle.

From High Bridge /Ijora Oloopa ramp to  Badiya intersection is a fast moving traffic on both lanes, we have flat bed trucks occupying one lane from  Total up bridge thru RRS checkpoint via Danlami up down to Area B, while the second lane is good to go for Cars and other vehicles.

Navy junction via Naval Dockyard is good to go at the moment.

Ijora 7'Up underneath the bridge / roundabout  still cool and calm. 

The movement of vehicles out of Apapa front Point road  through the Marine Bridge to Iganmu is equally fast moving traffic.

Officers are on ground doing the needful.
#FollowLASTMA
